notes.title: SURVIVAL MODE OUT NOW !!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=y0zKAbG_NqE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Survival Mode OUT NOW !![/h1]

Survival Mode is a one-life-to-live endless level set in a new wasteland biome.  Mow down glowing zombie hordes, survive radiation storms, and many other new hazards and obstacles. We created some new special abilities to unleash on post-apocalyptic traffic jams . Pickup vehicle upgrades to maximize your car's stats for a better chance of survival. Vehicle upgrades are also visual; watch your car turn into a beast.

For a more focused leaderboard experience, try your hand at weekly leaderboard seeds. Everyone competes on the same level playing field. See who can survive the longest and get the highest score. 

Please let us know of any issues you run into and we will try to fix them as soon as we can.

notes.title: Survival Update
notes.content:
Version 1.1.0 (4/27/22)

Features:
- New Game Modes:
  - Survival - Roguelike style level mode
  - Weekly - Survival Mode with a weekly seed and leaderboard
- New biome for survival with new hazards, encounters, and zombies
- Survival Mode special abilities and vehicle upgrades
- New leaderboards dialog, able to cycle through different leaderboards
- Credits dialog
- Military Hummer added to traffic
- Rock spawns in all biomes
- Multiple pages for How-To-Play, future expansion

Fixes:
- Optimize FPS, reduce hiccups
- Refactor the screen fade transitions
- Main Menu multiple buttons highlighting
- Fix traffic offroad treads for biomes
- Only upload highscores if game version matches
- Hitting deer and sasquatch not popping scores

notes.title: Commuter v1.0.2 Released!
notes.content:
We released our first game Commuter!  We hope you have fun taking out traffic and climbing the leaderboards.

We have some short term plans like adding a new game mode: Survival.  The Survival mode will start all players with a new unique car that can only be upgraded by collecting upgrade power-ups only available in Survival.  This mode is endless runner with the simple goal of staying alive as the level increases in difficulty.  Players can also swap out special abilities collected during play.  We are also thinking about having weekly seeds.

Another feature that will be added shortly is leaderboards per vehicle.

We anticipate some balancing changes as well based on some feedback.

Please send us any bugs you may come across in the community forums or on our Discord.

Stay tuned for more news.  Also, visit us at our Discord server:
https://discord.gg/Hd23VZdWAH

Thanks for playing!
- Brian & John @ Bad Neighbor Games
